data.key: Monk of the Empty Hand ~ Versatile Improvisation
data.name: Versatile Improvisation
data.description: At 3rd level, as a swift action, a monk of the empty hand may use an improvised weapon to deal damage as if it were another type (bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing) for 1 round, regardless of the weapon's normal damage type. This ability replaces still mind.

raw_tokens.value: Monk of the Empty Hand ~ Versatile Improvisation

At 3rd level, as a swift action, a monk of the empty hand may use an improvised weapon to deal damage as if it were another type (bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing) for 1 round, regardless of the weapon's normal damage type. This ability replaces still mind.
